title: Brightline Retail pilot scoping
summary_markdown:
## Decisions
- The Lumen pilot for Brightline Retail starts on October 14 and runs for six weeks.
- The pilot covers point-of-sale data from three stores: Denver, Austin and Portland.
- Okta SSO is included in the Enterprise tier at no extra cost; it is not an add-on.

## Next steps
- Alex Rivera sends Priya the security questionnaire by September 26.
- Sam Okafor sets up the pilot sandbox by October 7.
- Priya Shah gets budget sign-off from Dana Whitfield, VP of Operations at Brightline Retail.

## Notes
- Priya prefers short emails with bullet points.

transcript.text: Dana will ask me when the pilot starts and whether SSO costs extra, so I need both in writing.
October 14 for six weeks, and Okta SSO is part of Enterprise, so there is no add-on. I'll send the security questionnaire by Friday the 26th.
I'll have the sandbox with the three stores loaded by October 7.

title: Harborview Logistics renewal check-in
summary_markdown:
## Decisions
- Harborview Logistics renews on November 1.

## Next steps
- Alex Rivera checks with Lumen finance whether a 10% discount is possible for a two-year renewal, and answers Marco by October 3.

## Notes
- Marco Deluca is CTO of Harborview Logistics and signs the renewal himself.

transcript.text: If we commit to two years, I'd expect around ten percent off.
Let me check with finance and get back to you by October 3.
